However, RLS requires fulfillment of all four essential criteria (URGE-RLS): (1) an urge to move the legs, usually accompanied by uncomfortable sensations; (2) symptoms begin or worsen during rest/inactivity; (3) symptoms are partially or totally relieved by movement; and (4) symptoms are worse in the evening or night. We have evidence for criteria 2, 3, and 4. Criterion 1 (urge + uncomfortable sensations) has not yet been confirmed. Also, secondary causes (e.g., iron deficiency, renal disease, pregnancy, neuropathy) must be ruled out.
